title: Mac and gamepad fixes
summary: Stability and display fixes for Mac clients and fixes for gamepad play (the character selection screen and items that start a quest). No talent, spell or item changes.
sourceNote: We don't have Blizzard's original notes for this build; this entry summarizes the build log kept by ForeverChanges, and our own data (which did not change) confirms no talents, spells or items were touched.
